source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.9, printed pages 43-45.

blocks.text: Aap jandaron ki paanch kingdoms se waqif hain. Aap yeh bhi jaante hain ke kuch aisi makhlooq (creatures) bhi hai jin mein cellular organization (cell wali banawat) nahin hoti, phir bhi woh zinda cheezon ki kuch khoobiyan dikhati hai. Viruses aise hi jandaron ki numainda (representative) misal hain.
